name: Gorgias
task: A help desk, tickets or a shared inbox
summary: Helpdesk built for ecommerce: tickets, automations and an AI agent, priced by volume rather than by seat -- though the entry tier caps you at three users.
best_for: ecommerce support teams with seasonal or spiky volume, where per-agent pricing punishes you for having enough people on a busy week
skip_if: your volume is steady and low — 50 tickets a month is the entry allowance, and below that a shared inbox costs nothing; also skip the AI agent until you know your automated-interaction count, since that is the meter that runs away
honest_knock:
Never priced per agent is a real advantage, but it starts one tier up: the comparison table caps Starter at 3 user seats, and only Basic and above open the inbox to 500. On Basic upwards your whole team can be in there without the bill moving, which is the main reason to choose this over a per-seat helpdesk.

The cost sits on two meters instead, and both bite. Tickets beyond your allowance are $0.40 each on Starter and Basic, $0.36 on Pro and Advanced, so a bad week costs money rather than attention. And the AI agent -- the thing the homepage leads with -- is a separate $30 a month on the entry plan, which is three times the helpdesk it sits on. So the honest entry price for the product as advertised is $40, not $10.

Count a normal month's tickets and a busy month's, and price both. Then check the AI meter separately: the plan cards charge $1.50 per automated interaction past the included allowance while the comparison table on the same page says $1.00 to $0.85 depending on tier. When a vendor publishes two rates for the same meter, get the one that will be on your invoice in writing before you switch the agent on.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 8 September 2026 on their own pricing page) Not priced per agent -- their own line -- but the seats are capped: the comparison table gives Starter 3 user seats and Basic, Pro and Advanced 500 each. Two meters stack. Starter is $40/month all in, monthly billing only: a $10/month helpdesk with 50 tickets included and $0.40 per ticket beyond, plus the AI Agent at $30/month with 30 automated interactions. Basic is $90/month month-to-month or $77/month billed annually ($924 a year), including 300 tickets and 30 automated interactions with the same $0.40 ticket overage; the $50 helpdesk and $27 AI Agent printed on that card sum to the annual rate, not the monthly one. Pro is $550/month or $471/month billed annually ($5,652 a year) -- $300 helpdesk plus $171 AI Agent -- including 2,000 tickets and 190 automated interactions, with ticket overage falling to $0.36. Advanced is $1,430/month or $1,227/month billed annually ($14,724 a year) -- $750 plus $477 -- including 5,000 tickets and 530 automated interactions, also at $0.36. Above 5,000 conversations a month it is quote-only, and that custom tier is the only one with SSO via SAML, audit logs and an API above the 2 requests a second every listed plan gets. The page contradicts itself on the AI meter: every plan card says $1.50 per automated interaction past the limit, while the comparison table on the same page prices it at $1.00 on Starter, $0.90 on Basic and Pro and $0.85 on Advanced.

open_questions.question: Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Is there a minimum number of seats or users on any plan?
